messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up: engineering confirmed a brief ingestion slowdown from 02:20-02:46 PT that affected a small set of onboarding imports (8 accounts). Need a quick coordinated customer status + provisional credit plan.
Ravi (CS Ops): Can we get the account list and quick severity? I can draft two templates (trial vs paid).
Leo (Eng): Root cause: autoscaler mis-evaluated worker health during a config rollout and evicted some warm workers. We rolled back at 02:46 PT and injected extra capacity; requeues started at 02:50. No data exposure.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-211 created: ingest-autoscaler-eviction. Severity: P3.
Hannah (Onboarding): I have three enablement calls today. Which customers are impacted so I can offer make-good slots?
Maya (CSM): Affected: PaperKite, NimbusAI, ForgeDocs, Lexify, MeadowForms, BrightForms (trial); OmniLegal, ApexSynth (paid POC). Prioritize OmniLegal and NimbusAI for outreach.
Priya (Billing): Provisional credit guidance: up to $1,000 for paid POCs pending CSM impact notes. Approvals fast-tracked if renewal-risk flagged.
Ravi (CS Ops): Draft status note: "Hi <CustomerTeam>, we saw a short ingestion slowdown between 02:20-02:46 PT that delayed some onboarding imports. We've requeued affected jobs and most work is complete; remaining items will finish within 2 hours. We'll follow with an RCA and any account-specific remediation. No customer data was exposed. — Redwood CS"
Maya (CSM): Good. Hannah please call NimbusAI and OmniLegal; offer a priority make-good onboarding slot and confirm if they want an exec sync.
Hannah (Onboarding): Will call NimbusAI now and post results here.
Leo (Eng): Postmortem timeline: public draft in 48 hours, internal RCA in 72. Fixes: add warmup gate and pre-rollout smoke test for long-running imports.
Ravi (CS Ops): Sending status to all affected with ticket refs and assigning owners. CSM owners: Maya -> OmniLegal, ApexSynth; Hannah -> PaperKite, ForgeDocs, MeadowForms; Ravi -> outbound messages + ticket list.
Incident Bot: Requeue validation: 8/8 jobs completed at 03:10 PT. Incident status: mitigated.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Capture any customer feedback on unclear errors in the onboarding tracker and escalate any renewal concerns to me.
